verdicts.reason: A is mostly a straight transfer of the original onto the square canvas: the hierarchy and reading order are intact, but the pills are spread too far apart, the date and details block now sits on the pink circle, the phone is shoved toward the right edge, and the bottom third is dead space around tiny legal text and the missing-asset placeholder. B is scrambled: the RSVP CTA has been shrunk into a pill among the badges at the top, the phone overlaps the circle, 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits below its own headline, the date, tagline, URL and time are jammed together on ragged left and center axes, and the URL now looks like the body copy.
